text:
nativeapi

Unified access to native system APIs — windows, tray icons, menus, displays, keyboard, dialogs, storage and more — from Dart/Flutter, Rust, C , JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Go and Swift, all built on one C++ core.

 Android iOS Linux macOS Windows 
 :-------: :---: :-----: :-----: :-------: 
 ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ ✅ 

🚧 Work in Progress : the API is under active development.

This repository is the home of every binding: the Dart, Rust, C , JS, Python, Go and Swift bindings, the code generator, the design specs and the shared tooling live here directly, and the C++ core (nativeapi-core) is checked out as a git submodule. A core change and its regenerated bindings (core → codegen → bindings) are made and tracked together.

 Bindings

 Binding Packages Status 
 --- --- --- 
 Dart / Flutter nativeapi , cnativeapi on pub.dev; nativeapi flutter (not yet published) published 
 Rust nativeapi , cnativeapi on crates.io published 
 C NativeAPI not yet on NuGet; build from source 
 JavaScript / TypeScript nativeapi (Node-API addon for Node.js, Deno and Bun) not yet on npm 
 Python nativeapi ( ctypes , Python 3.10+) prototype, not yet on PyPI 
 Go github.com/libnativeapi/nativeapi/bindings/go (cgo, Go 1.22+) build from source 
 Swift NativeAPI (SwiftPM, macOS 11+, Swift 5.9+) build from source 

Each binding's README covers installation and usage.

Native Shell examples demonstrate using nativeapi from NSH
Rust apps: tray icons with native menus, global shortcuts and message dialogs.

 History

This repository was nativeapi-flutter , then nativeapi-workspace , and is now nativeapi ; the old names redirect here, and its history, issues and stars carry over. The histories of the former workspace , nativeapi-rust and nativeapi-csharp repositories are merged in, so the Rust and C bindings keep their full history under bindings/ . The old nativeapi-rust and nativeapi-csharp repositories are archived.

 Layout

 Path Description 
 --- --- 
 core submodule: the C++ core library ( nativeapi-core ) 
 bindings/dart Dart binding (packages nativeapi , cnativeapi , nativeapi flutter ) 
 bindings/rust Rust binding (crates nativeapi , cnativeapi ) 
 bindings/csharp C binding 
 bindings/js JavaScript / TypeScript binding (Node-API addon) 
 bindings/python Python binding ( ctypes ) 
 bindings/go Go binding (cgo) 
 bindings/swift Swift binding (SwiftPM) 
 examples example apps of every binding, prefixed by binding: flutter , rust , csharp , js , python , go , swift , … 
 tools/codegen the C ABI and binding generators 
 specs design rules for the core's public API 

 Getting started

 

Already cloned without --recursive ?

 

The root pubspec.yaml is the pub workspace (and melos) root for the Dart packages and the Flutter examples, and the root Cargo.toml is the cargo workspace for the Rust crates and examples, so flutter pub get and cargo build run from the repository root. The C solution is bindings/csharp/NativeAPI.slnx .

 Code generation

 tools/codegen generates the C ABI and all language bindings from the C++ headers in core/ . Run it via the wrapper script:

 

See tools/codegen/README.md for details.

 Common tasks

 

Work on the bindings, the tooling and the specs is committed here directly. Work inside core is committed and pushed from that subdirectory as if it were a standalone clone; this repository then records the updated pointer once the combination is known to be compatible.

 Issues

- API requests and native behavior bugs → nativeapi-core issues
- Bugs specific to one binding → nativeapi issues

 Releases

Each binding is released from a tag of its own: v publishes the Dart packages to pub.dev ( dart-release.yml ), rust-v publishes the crates to crates.io ( rust-release.yml ). The C , JS, Python and Go bindings are not published yet.

git submodule update --init --recursive
